conventions.convention: The frame-bundle coordinate is b: R^m → T_xM; the normal trivialization is its inverse. A regular-preimage framing is β composed with df, where β sends the chosen positive target basis to the standard basis.
Hopf classification concerns free homotopy classes, positive dimension m ≥ 1, and closed connected domains; the oriented domain is explicitly nonempty. Countable choice is assumed.
The sphere has outward-normal-first orientation. The explicit pinch model has local sign (−1)^(m+1) at its south-pole preimage; chart signs compensate for this.
Disjoint unions of framed cobordisms require disjoint cobordism images, not merely disjoint endpoints.

Whitney disks are smooth cornered bigons with prescribed product corner collars. Their normal rank is m−2; the rounded boundary circle has normal rank m−1. An admissible framing may be corrected within a summand; an arbitrary prescribed full frame is not asserted to extend.
The auxiliary ambient flow acts on one selected sheet while the comparison sheet remains fixed; applying it to both images preserves intersections.
The borderline Whitney theorem requires s ≥ 3 and m ≥ 5, and complement fundamental-group injection when r ≤ 2. Simple connectivity alone is not substituted for that injection.

Surgery uses 2p+2 ≤ m. The action is initially by π1(M), identified with π1(X) only when f induces an isomorphism. Relative degree two uses normal closure when nonabelian; relative degree one is a pointed coset set.

Oriented normal surgery on a zero-sphere requires determinant transport compatible with the incoming data. Orientability of the target stable bundle, compatibly oriented, supplies this for every core path.
All immersion spaces use the weak compact-open C-infinity topology; formal spaces use the product subspace topology on base maps and total-space bundle maps.

A compact parameter pair has P=P0×[0,1]^d with P0 a compact boundaryless smooth manifold and Q closed. Smoothly holonomic on Q means the original family is smooth and holonomic on an open parameter neighbourhood of Q.

Core restriction requires k<n and retains all m source columns. Formal boundary data separately retain the actual radial base derivative C; C=B(r) is imposed only on genuine data. Cocore directions remain source directions.

Open source means no compact connected component. Equal dimensions are allowed for open sources; general boundaryless sources require positive codimension. The conclusions are weak equivalence and separately qualified relative-family results.

Countable choice is carried through the general smooth constructions. The branched-cover, rational-ball torsion, trefoil and disk-cleaning obstruction items explicitly assume full AC for their stronger suppliers.

load_bearing.statement: Assume ACω and 0≤k≤m≤n with k<n, with N boundaryless. Restriction of holonomic full-m-column core data on D^k to its boundary data is a Serre fibration. Formal restriction, retaining the boundary base values, full monomorphism and independent actual radial base derivative, is also a Serre fibration. Compact smooth parameter lifting is supplied by finite parameter fragmentation.

Assume ACω and boundaryless N^n. For 0≤k≤n, derivative on the closed disk is a weak homotopy equivalence, with finite-CW relative lifting up to homotopy. For k<n, the stated smooth compact parameter family, with P boundaryless, originally holonomic near Q and a closed boundary collar A, admits holonomization fixed on Q and A.

Assume ACω and 0≤k≤m≤n with k<n. Attaching an m-dimensional k-handle to compact A preserves derivative weak equivalence when it holds on A. The stated compact-parameter formal family, genuine on a source neighbourhood of A and smoothly holonomic near its closed relative parameter set Q, admits holonomization relative to A and Q.

Assume countable choice. For boundaryless open M^m with no compact connected component and boundaryless N^n with m≤n, derivative Imm(M,N)→FImm(M,N) is a weak homotopy equivalence in the weak C-infinity topology. Compact parameter pairs with original data smoothly holonomic near Q admit holonomization relative to Q; smooth input admits a smooth relative deformation.

Assume countable choice. For boundaryless smooth M^m,N^n with m<n, derivative Imm(M,N)→FImm(M,N) is a weak homotopy equivalence in the weak C-infinity topology. The stated compact parameter pairs with original data smoothly holonomic on an open neighbourhood of Q admit relative holonomization; smooth input admits smooth relative deformation.

Assume ACω. A clean framed Whitney bigon for complementary sheet neighbourhoods of dimensions a,b≥1, with compatible product corner collars and admissible extended disk-normal frame, has an embedded product tube over an open plane extension. Its designated sheet inverse images are exactly the respective extended edges with their respective normal blocks. The tube represents the supplied normal quotient framing and can exclude closed unwanted sheet parts disjoint from the disk.

Assume ACω. A clean admissibly framed Whitney bigon for complementary sheet neighbourhoods of dimensions at least one gives a compactly supported auxiliary ambient isotopy applied to the first sheet with the second fixed, removing exactly the prescribed pair without new intersections. For an immersion patch it gives a regular homotopy when the supporting tube misses other source-image branches.

Assume ACω. Let complementary transverse closed connected sheets A^r,B^s lie in boundaryless X^m, with s≥3, m≥5, A oriented and νB oriented. If r≤2 additionally assume π1(X∖B)→π1(X) injective. An opposite-sign pair with specified avoiding embedded arcs whose concatenation contracts admits an ambient isotopy removing precisely that pair and fixing neighbourhoods of the other intersections.

Assume ACω. For compact smooth N^n and boundaryless M^m with m≥2n+1, every smooth map admits arbitrarily C1-close smoothly homotopic embeddings. Relative agreement on closed C requires injectivity on C and injectivity of the ambient differential there. A prescribed embedded boundary map can first receive an embedded collar extension.

Assume ACω. Attaching an n-cell, n≥2, to connected smooth M and extending f:M→X over it preserves relative map homotopy below n and gives a surjection in degree n. For n≥3 the kernel is generated by π1(M)-translates of the represented class; for n=2 use their normal closure. A 1-cell enlarges the source-image fundamental subgroup by its represented core loop.

Assume ACω. For the stated connected-source degree-one normal map, embedded representative of x∈π_(p+1)(f), supplied target nullhomotopy and 2p+2≤m, the rank-(m−p) sphere normal bundle has an actual trivialization compatible after stabilization and homotopy with the prescribed stable framing. For p=0 require compatible determinant transport. The map and stable normal data extend over the trace, yielding a normally bordant degree-one endpoint over the same finite-CW target datum.

Assume ACω. For nonempty closed connected oriented smooth M^m, m≥1, signed count bijects framed cobordism classes of closed framed zero-submanifolds with Z, is additive under disjoint union, and vanishes exactly for framed null-cobordant configurations. The classes form a commutative monoid isomorphic to (Z,+).

Assume ACω. For closed connected nonorientable smooth M^m, m≥1, parity bijects framed cobordism classes of closed framed zero-submanifolds with Z/2, is additive under disjoint union, and is zero exactly for framed null-cobordant configurations.

Assume ACω. For nonempty closed connected oriented smooth M^m, m≥1, smooth maps M→S^m are smoothly homotopic iff their degrees agree, every integer degree occurs, and degree bijects free homotopy classes of continuous maps with Z. Continuous degree is defined using any homotopic smooth representative.

Assume ACω. For closed connected nonorientable smooth M^m, m≥1, smooth maps M→S^m are smoothly homotopic iff their mod-two degrees agree. Both values occur, represented by a constant map and a coordinate-ball pinch, and mod-two degree bijects free continuous homotopy classes with Z/2.

concerns.concern: The Given paragraph specifies only a smooth base map f and a separate fibrewise injective F. Proof 2.1 then asserts that some maximal minor of J_f is nonzero by L1. For part (i), the proof must first take f∈Imm(M,N); an independent formal monomorphism F does not imply df is injective. Adding that starting premise closes the standard openness argument immediately.

F1 says, 'The mapping cylinder identifies the source with its bottom face and the target with its top face.' The cited def-mapping-cylinder-and-mapping-cone fixes (x,0)∼f(x), and embeds the source by j(x)=[x,1]. The face labels are reversed. The subsequent triple argument does not appear to rely on those labels.

The Definition calls relative homotopy 'H constant on A×[0,1]'. Read literally this requires one value across A as well as time. The cited relative-homotopy convention requires H(a,t)=H(a,0) for each a, allowing different values at different points of A. State time-independence pointwise.

alerts.finding: F4 says, 'continuous families can be smoothed rel the parameter boundary', citing lem-smooth-families-and-path-components-in-the-weak-topology. That supplier requires the original adjoint data to be smooth near the relative set; its unconditional endpoint assertion concerns paths. The unqualified family assertion is false: on P=[0,1]^2, translate a fixed immersed circle by (|s−1/2|,0). This is a continuous immersion family whose restriction to the top and bottom parameter edges is nonsmooth in s, so no jointly smooth family can agree with it on the whole parameter boundary. The component-identification use in Proof 4.1 remains supported; the broader F4 clause needs its missing qualification.

seams_checked.note: Opened framing, cobordism, regular-preimage, regular-value independence and both collapse comparison suppliers. Owned citations retain closed sources, ACω, positive target dimension where needed, positive bases, quotient-framing direction and free versus disjoint-basepoint homotopy.
The actual supplier is the complementary-sheet product-chart lemma, used for Whitney corners. Its complementary tangent-sum hypothesis and local chart conclusion are retained.

Opened normal-map, surgery-sphere, trace and upper-boundary suppliers. Consumers retain actual framed product embeddings, the p+1 index shift, dual q-cell model and the p=0 orientation caveat. Finite-CW normal extension is proved locally rather than attributed to the narrower smooth-target supplier.

Opened triad, relative handle, Morse correspondence, finite CW model and dual top-index elimination statements. No-top-index construction checks outgoing nonemptiness componentwise. CW citations retain the distinction between a finite CW model and a supplied CW structure on the actual incoming manifold.

Positive-codimension Smale–Hirsch and compact-source component citations in Whitney–Graustein, sphere classification and eversion are faithful. However, lem-regular-homotopy-preserves-the-formal-gauss-class F4 omits the neighbourhood-smooth hypothesis in its broader relative-family smoothing clause; see alert.

Actual uses concern the definition of regular homotopy: a smooth family with every source slice immersive. Consumers keep isotopy through embeddings separate and permit intermediate branch tangency without source rank drop.

The immersion-disjunction consumer retains opposite compatible signs, chosen nullhomotopic arcs, m≥3, a disk avoiding the entire immersed image, admissible framing correction, and action on only one source patch. It explicitly handles other branches and initial triple images.

Normal-quotient and tangent-normal citations preserve actual rank and metric-dependent splitting. Rank-reduction sufficiency uses ACω, closed boundaryless source and k≥1, and derives existence from the component bijection rather than claiming a canonical immersion.

Stable cancellations use both sheet dimensions at least three. The two-dimensional endpoint cases establish complement injection for actual handle belts from the incoming fundamental-group hypothesis; they do not infer it from outgoing simple connectivity alone. Frame construction retains disk-normal rank and adjustable admissible data.
